notes.title: Patch 1.25 Released! - Hint System For Bonus Levels Added!
notes.content:
Patch 1.25 Released! 

Hint System For Bonus Levels Added!

Hints will recharge up to 3 times while you are playing the bonus levels and they do save as well. Hopefully this makes some of the bonus levels a bit easier for people that choose to use the hints!

notes.title: Patch 1.18 Released! - Hint Bank Feature Out Now!
notes.content:
The Hint Bank feature has now been released! Earn EXTRA hints when completing the mini game that are stored & saved! 

Turning this feature on means as long as you complete a mini game not only will you gain the standard hint for the level but you will also gain an extra hint into your bonus hint bank that can be used in future levels that you may be stuck on! 

This feature should be great for players that perhaps still are unable to find the Sneaky Snacks after using the initial hints you start off with.

Please note that this feature does not work in the BONUS LEVELS as no hints are allowed in that area but it will work for the full storyline mode. 

Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 1.17 Released! - Replay Levels Feature Out Now
notes.content:
Due to popular demand you can now replay completed levels once you beat the Sneaky Snacks Story mode! Not only that you can also replay the bonus levels once you beat all of them! 

Requirements: 
Beat all 20 levels in story mode to unlock replay feature for story mode levels
Beat all 10 levels in bonus mode to unlock replay feature for bonus levels

Hint mini game mode is disabled on replay mode due to incompatibilities but technically if you are replaying mini game mode more than likely isn't needed but you can also hit new game to start fresh for the full new game experience.

Known Issues:
When exiting and entering a replayed level on the same run the object system may not show the green tick on found items this will be worked on in the future but technically the item is coloured in still as found and you can continue searching for the missing snacks but the tick will not be prompted for found snacks already once reloaded for now. (again this only happens if you leave a repeated level and try and complete it again half way through) 

Hope you all enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 1.16 Released! - Timeless Mode Released!
notes.content: Due to popular demand a timeless mode has been released for Sneaky Snacks! This removes the timer from the game for people who just want to play and relax. More levels are on the way as well so stay tuned and I hope you enjoy.

notes.title: Patch 1.15 Released! - Steam Achievements Added!
notes.content: The newest patch of Sneaky Snacks has now introduced Steam Achievements per request of you players! If you have already started the game you will need to start a new game by going into OPTIONS > NEW GAME and start your journey again but this time you will be rewarded with achievements!
